Your job is to add or extend CoreEx.Data.GraphQL (GraphQL-lite) on a CoreEx API host following the project's established conventions.

Read and follow `.github/skills/coreex-graphql/references/workflow.md` exactly. Do not skip steps or invent patterns not shown there.

Reminder of key conventions:
- Additive and opt-in — only wire this up when explicitly asked, never proactively
- Check the host's `Program.cs` for `AddCoreExGraphQLLite` and its `AGENTS.md` for a `**GraphQL:**` line before assuming first-time enablement
- Roots bridge to an entity's **existing** `QueryArgsConfig` + `QueryAsync`/`GetAsync` — never invent new filter/sort logic for GraphQL
- Resolve scoped dependencies per-invocation via `CoreEx.ExecutionContext.GetRequiredService<T>()` — `IGraphQLEngine` is a singleton
- `app.MapCoreExGraphQLLite(...)` must come after `app.MapControllers()`
- `AddReferenceDataQueries(sp, ReferenceDataQueryArgsConfig.Default)` bulk-registers reference data roots
- `EnableIntrospection` defaults to `false`; the endpoint is anonymous by default — confirm authorization requirements explicitly
- Record enablement as a plain `**GraphQL:**` line in the host's `AGENTS.md` "This Host's Feature Configuration" section
